name: Repo Run Check
description: Before running a GitHub repo or a pasted shell command, flags risky install scripts, curl-pipe-to-shell patterns, editor autorun tasks, typosquatted dependencies and fake-star signals. Tools: check_repo, check_command (free) and full_report_info (explains the optional paid deeper check, 0.005 USDC on Base over x402; the tool itself does not pay). No account or API key.
